prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Redesign the ARCHITECTURAL GEOMETRY of this exact painted greenhouse concept while retaining its warmth, palette, materials, herbs, shelves, lantern, brick paving and central growing bench. The room must have a SQUARE FLOOR PLAN with ONE FLAT STRAIGHT BACK WALL and TWO FLAT STRAIGHT SIDE WALLS meeting at clearly visible SHARP 90-DEGREE CORNERS. Absolutely NO curved wall, semicircular alcove, rounded bay, bowed glazing or faceted approximation of a curve. Replace all arched window and door heads with RECTANGULAR SQUARE-TOPPED windows and rectangular glazed double doors, with simple straight mullions. Use a conventional straight-ridged pitched GLASS ROOF: straight sloping rafters and straight crossbeams, with angular diagonal braces, NO fan roof, curved ribs or arched beams. The growing BENCHES must also be strictly RECTILINEAR: one straight bench across the flat back wall, straight side benches meeting it at hard square 90-degree corners, and a substantial SQUARE CENTRAL ISLAND growing bench with four sharp right-angle corners. Benches are broad waist-high planting surfaces on open sage-green timber legs with straight diagonal braces, lower shelves, baskets and terracotta pots. Bench edges, rims, shelves and legs must be straight, with NO rounded ends, curved contours, bowed fronts, rounded corners or scrollwork. Keep an aisle around all sides of the square center island, access to right-hand rectangular glass doors, cottage herb shelves at left, lush existing mixed herb groups and visible dark soil in each bench. View from the entry toward the middle of the flat back wall, coherent rectilinear perspective; the square island naturally appears foreshortened, with its farther edge shorter than its near edge. Broad square room, not a narrow tunnel. Preserve beautiful hand-painted watercolor/gouache texture, delicate ink contours, weathered sage-green wood, golden worn edges, soft cream plaster, honey sun, leafy climbing vines, forest through the glass and warm storybook apothecary atmosphere. Natural plant shapes and ordinary round pots are fine, but there must be ZERO CURVES IN THE WALL, WINDOW-FRAME, DOOR-FRAME, ROOF-BEAM OR BENCH DESIGN. No text, labels, UI, people or watermark.
